states.name: cultural-revolution-us-holds
states.description: USSR to act, the US holds the China Card (face up). Cultural Revolution makes the US hand it over face up.

states.name: cultural-revolution-ussr-holds
states.description: USSR to act and already holding the China Card: Cultural Revolution pays the USSR 1 VP instead.

states.name: nixon-ussr-holds
states.description: US to act, the USSR holds the China Card (face up). Nixon passes it to the US face down.

states.name: nixon-us-holds
states.description: US to act and already holding the China Card (face down): Nixon pays the US 2 VP instead.

states.name: ussuri-ussr-holds
states.description: US to act, the USSR holds the China Card (face up). Ussuri River Skirmish passes it to the US face up, no choices.

states.name: ussuri-us-holds
states.description: US to act and already holding the China Card: Ussuri River Skirmish adds 4 US influence in Asia, at most 2 per country.

states.name: china-card-asia-bonus
states.description: USSR to act with the face-up China Card (4 ops): spent wholly in Asia it is worth 5. The USSR has 1 influence in Japan.
